title: Agent SDKs and runtime workers
requirement: Give a worker structured events, custom tools or session control through a supported SDK when the native CLI's bounded review is not enough.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Qualify a concrete application need (durable multi-host state, explicit graph checkpoints, a remote/container worker or programmatic Claude session control) before promoting a deferred SDK alternative; the SDK table in docs/foundation-closure-20260921.md (lines 78-84) has not been revisited by any lane since 2026-09-21.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
